test_cases.test_case: Rapid repeated toggling of 'Star this course' from the course menu
preconditions: User is logged in as a teacher
At least one course card that is not currently starred is visible
Course list contains multiple items so pinned order is observable
steps: 1. Locate the target course card
2. Click the course card's three-dot menu to open it
3. Click 'Star this course' once
4. Immediately (within 1 second) click 'Star this course' again
5. Observe the course list and the target card's state
test_cases.expected_result: The first 'Star this course' action succeeds: the target course is shown in a starred/pinned state and appears at the top of the list. Subsequent rapid clicks are ignored or queued until the first action completes; no duplicate pins or duplicate course cards appear. The UI shows a single pinned state indicator on the course and the list order visibly reflects a single pin action.

3. Click 'Remove from view'

2. Click '+ Add an activity or resource' in the <target section>
3. In the Activity Chooser modal click the 'Workshop' tile's star/favorite toggle
test_cases.expected_result: Workshop tile shows favorited state (star filled) or unfavorited state toggled accordingly

test_cases.test_case: Enable Edit mode as unauthenticated user
preconditions: Course page is publicly accessible or reachable
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page URL while not logged in
2. Attempt to click the 'Enable edit mode' control
test_cases.expected_result: The action is blocked: the user is redirected to the login/authentication page or shown an authentication prompt; the Course page does not enter authoring interface; inline edit controls (section/activity edit icons, '+ Add an activity or resource' buttons) are not displayed.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt quick-rename when Edit mode is disabled
preconditions: User is authenticated with normal course-view access
Course page is open with Edit mode OFF (view-only)
steps: 1. Locate a section on the Course page
2. Attempt to click the section's inline edit (rename) icon
test_cases.expected_result: The action is blocked: the inline edit/rename control is not present or is not interactive when Edit mode is OFF; no rename input appears; the section title remains unchanged.

test_cases.test_case: Open Activity Chooser and click Add without selecting a tile
preconditions: User is authenticated with authoring privileges
Edit mode is enabled on the Course page
steps: 1. With the Activity Chooser modal open, do not select any activity/resource tile
2. Click the modal's 'Add' button
test_cases.expected_result: The action is blocked: the Activity Chooser remains open; no activity creation form opens; an inline validation indicator appears in the modal stating a tile must be selected (Add does not proceed); no activity/resource is added to the course.

test_cases.test_case: Select 'Resources' filter then attempt to add an Activity tile not visible under that filter
preconditions: User is authenticated with authoring privileges
Edit mode is enabled on the Course page
steps: 1. In the Activity Chooser, select the 'Resources' category filter
2. Attempt to locate and select the Assignment activity tile (an Activity) while the filter is set to 'Resources'
3. Click the modal's 'Add' button
test_cases.expected_result: The action is blocked: Assignment tile is not present in the grid under the 'Resources' filter; the user cannot select Assignment; Add remains disabled or shows a validation state until a visible tile is selected; no Assignment creation form opens and no activity is added.

test_cases.test_case: Apply a bulk action with no activities selected
preconditions: User is authenticated with authoring privileges
Edit mode is enabled on the Course page
steps: 1. Ensure no activities are selected (no checkboxes checked)
2. Open the bulk actions dropdown and choose a bulk operation (e.g., Move)
3. Click the 'Apply' button for the chosen bulk action
test_cases.expected_result: The action is blocked: the bulk action does not execute; an inline validation message is displayed on the bulk actions toolbar indicating that at least one activity must be selected; no activities are affected.

test_cases.test_case: Search in Activity Chooser returns no results then attempt to Add
preconditions: User is authenticated with authoring privileges
Edit mode is enabled on the Course page
steps: 1. Enter <search term that yields no results> into the Activity Chooser search field
2. Confirm the grid shows no tiles for that search
3. Click the modal's 'Add' button
test_cases.expected_result: The action is blocked: the grid displays a 'no results' state and no tiles are selectable; the 'Add' button is disabled or triggers an inline validation indicating selection is required; no creation form opens and nothing is added.

test_cases.test_case: Quick rename a section with a very long name
preconditions: User with editing privileges is on the course page
steps: 1. Click the 'Enable Edit mode' control
2. Click the edit (rename) icon on a section
3. Focus the inline section name input
4. Paste a very long string (200+ characters) into the inline name field
5. Press Enter to save the new name
test_cases.expected_result: Either: the rename succeeds and the section header displays the saved name (succeeds); OR the rename is blocked and an inline validation error is shown indicating the name exceeds the maximum allowed length (is blocked / error shown). The chosen outcome must be visible immediately in the inline edit area.

test_cases.test_case: Quick rename an activity with leading and trailing whitespace
preconditions: User with editing privileges is on the course page
steps: 1. Click the 'Enable Edit mode' control
2. Click the edit (rename) icon on an activity row
3. Focus the inline activity name input
4. Type a valid name with leading and trailing spaces (e.g., '  Name  ')
5. Press Enter to save the new name
test_cases.expected_result: The rename succeeds; leading and trailing whitespace are trimmed and the activity row displays the saved name without extra spaces (succeeds). The inline editor closes and the activity list shows the trimmed name.

test_cases.test_case: Use special characters and emoji in Activity Chooser search
preconditions: User with editing privileges is on the course page
steps: 1. Click the 'Enable Edit mode' control
2. Click '+ Add an activity or resource' at the bottom of a section to open the Activity Chooser modal
3. Click the search field in the Activity Chooser
4. Type a string containing special characters and emoji into the search field (for example: punctuation, symbols, emoji)
5. Press Enter (or click the search control) to execute the search
test_cases.expected_result: Search executes without UI errors and the modal remains open (succeeds). If no tiles match, the chooser displays a visible 'No results' or equivalent message; if tiles match special characters they are shown. Any error from the search must be visible in the modal.

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly toggle favorite (star) on an Assignment tile
preconditions: User with editing privileges is on the course page
steps: 1. Click the 'Enable Edit mode' control
2. Click '+ Add an activity or resource' to open the Activity Chooser modal
3. Locate the Assignment tile in the chooser grid
4. Observe and note the current star (favorite) state for the Assignment tile
5. Click the star toggle on the Assignment tile twice rapidly (two clicks in quick succession)
6. Close the Activity Chooser modal
7. Reopen the Activity Chooser modal
8. Inspect the Assignment tile's star state
test_cases.expected_result: After the rapid toggles the tile ends in a single, consistent favorite state and that state persists when the chooser is reopened (succeeds). The star indicator visibly matches the persisted state; there is no duplicated favorite entry or inconsistent UI state after reopening the modal.

test_cases.test_case: Save is blocked when multiple edits include a single invalid cell; only the invalid cell is flagged

test_cases.test_case: Browser Back immediately after logout

test_cases.test_case: Logout in one tab then perform action in another tab with stale authenticated UI

test_cases.expected_result: Protected action/refresh in Tab B is blocked due to terminated session; Tab B is redirected to or shows the login page (access is blocked / error shown indicating re-authentication is required).
